description: Get a price for registering a domain for a storefront, held for 15 minutes. A quote costs nothing and registers nothing: only the workspace owner can buy it, in the dashboard. Only where domain search is switched on (else an error with code not_released). Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

domain.description: The domain to price, such as acme.ai.

name: quote_storefront_domain
